positions.title: iOS Mobile Application Developer, Self Service Engineering
iOS Engineer
positions.description: Worked as part of SocialCode’s first mobile development group.

positions.title: Senior Apple Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on all things Cocoa and Apple!

- Added content unfurling in messages stream, GIF, YouTube, Vimeo links now unfurl inline.
- Face feature aware avatars
- Added ability to use the Accelerate framework for image manipulations
- Setup iOS CI and added various unit tests

Guided Avocado's iOS app through the major iOS 7 updates. Including implementation of a number of new features (while keeping our binary iOS 6 compliant):
- All new NSURLSession networking stack with background downloads of media using NSURLSession background sessions
- Added background fetch and remote notification background modes to keep the app up to date
- Implemented new store for messages, ties into background modes
- Implemented all new design for iOS 7, flat design with blurred transparency touches
- Added Airdrop support


Also worked on ARM64 migration for the new iPhone 5S, and other enhancements, some soon to be released projects as well, stay tuned!

positions.title: iOS / Android Developer
positions.description: Developed/Managed the main client facing iOS application, including bringing iPad support, Core Data internals, and a native/web bridging system.   Developed a client facing Android App that brought feature parody to Android, which now supports all features that were only supported on iOS. Also developed internal apps for both iOS (iPhone/iPad) and Android for internal operations.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
bSerene developed for the iPhone / iPod Touch (on the App Store now)

Search the iOS App Store for bSerene (For a Buddhist group fund-raiser).

Various other applications developed for various clients (ask for more info). Most of my current work has been with private clients, details and examples can be provided, but the applications are managed privately.

positions.title: Chief Technical Officer
positions.description:
Creation and design of a new website application suite for SEO optimized car dealer
websites. Design and programming of the massive backend processes needed to route incoming
data on avalible inventory and their photos and videos. Design and implementation of a
pure XServe server cluster powered with a promise RAID array and XSan. Creation and
programming of iPhone, and iPad optimized versions of the websites inventory. Creation and
programming of a website application control panel for our clients using a native custom
installed iPhone and iPad application.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Design and implementation of Linux cluster server. Development of Linux daemons to allow
our Windows / Mac based client software to distribute calculations to the Linux cluster.
Maintenance of Mac OS X version of HyperChem. Porting of old SGI cluster daemon code to
modern Linux cluster daemons and interfaces.

positions.title: Mac Software Developer
positions.description:
Java development of P2P applications using UDP networking. Developed in Java 6.0.
Software updating system. Mobile version created for cell phones using J2ME CLDC. Mobile
device support for Blackberry / Palm / Nokia / LG. Creation of server relaying software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design of Fire Service software. NIFERS5 compliant form automation. EMS dispatching
software. Palm OS / WM5 mobile version designed and developed

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Unix Server Administration. Design/Development of Patient Progress 2000 a patient
management, session note, and medical file system. VB6 OOP development. MS SQL
